name: addk_sim
_note: SIM model descriptor (NOT a real .tflite). Compiled by tools/vela/vela_gen.py into a .npub container whose command stream is the documented SE55 sim convention (libs/ra8_hal/inc/ra8_npu_sim_cmd.h): add-constant K=17 of region 1 (input) -> region 2 (output). The ra8_emulator NPU model and the ra8_npu driver decode the same convention, so the golden runs end-to-end without a Vela toolchain or an RA8P1 board. Real Vela compilation of a genuine .tflite is the `compile` subcommand.
